Region · India

India CPRO & BPRO

Shark Tank TV launch, full-funnel impact on demand, and a Q3 OOH incrementality test for Acrobat.
India · BPRODemand creation

TV launch with Shark Tank delivered +77% Y/Y Sourced Units and a clear correlation lift on gross units

Correlation · gross units vs spend
0.91
Up from 0.83 across full campaign duration. Awareness activity is not captured in ACE, so direct impact lands in gross unit growth rather than sourced units.

+77% Sourced Units Y/Y, +69% gross units on Acrobat in IN. The launch of TV plus increased mobile spend directly impacted demand and unit volume.

$867K Shark Tank sponsorship reached 14.8M in core target group (89.6M impressions, 10.08 GRPs) and a further 3.14M in the extended group, complemented by 14.25M FOC digital impressions across CTV and Mobile.

Q3 thesis: OOH on top of TV + Digital is estimated to drive +10.22% in unaided awareness vs +9.75% for TV-only — to be validated in a controlled GeoX/MMT test through 27 June – 31 July.

Source: Google Search dashboard; Spend data: DOT and PPP; Sourced Units: Executive dashboard; Reach: oOh! / CX Tool.

India · CPROCreative messaging

Messaging effectiveness flips by funnel stage — feature-led messages drove engagement; outcome-led drove conversion

Demand Progression

Feature & reliability messages drove engaged visits

5.5%
Peak CTR on Meta CLC assets — short-form, platform-native creatives
  • Reliability and Seamless workflow drove the most engaged visits.
  • Cloud / AutoSave functions sparked prospecting interest.
  • Value-for-Money did not resonate at consideration.
Demand Conversion

Outcome & price messages drove sourced units

+58%
YouTube QRF outperformance, with Meta at +27% — both led by outcome-led creative
  • Time saving, Quality & Comprehensive, and Pretty Pricing drove the highest Net Orders.
  • Display drives last-step conversion, so Promo dominates volume.
  • Q3 ask: tailor messaging by platform mindset, not a single global creative.
Source: DOT, Platform data. Reporting period: FY26Q1 W1–10. Performance varies by platform; YouTube weight skews aggregate engagement.

Region · Australia & New Zealand

ANZ BPRO & CPRO

First full-funnel quarter for Acrobat Studio. Toluna brand lift confirms aided AI perception is moving.
ANZ · BPROFull-funnel impact

Adding Creation to the funnel lifted Conversion outcomes without lifting Conversion spend

Reach uplift
2.9×
greater 1+ Reach when Meta Creation went live (W7–13) versus Conversion-only weeks.
Conversion uplift
1.2×
greater conversions, despite D.Conv weekly spend dropping -20% over the same window.
CVR uplift
+17.6%
higher CVR for full-funnel exposed audiences vs D.Conv-only — and CPA 33% more efficient Y/Y.
SO WHAT
Creation is additive, not cannibalising — at higher scale, full-funnel exposed users converted 1.07% vs 0.85% for Conversion-only.
Q2 implications: hold Creation investment, expand TTD into VOD/CTV for retargeting handoffs, and front-load Creation/Progression ahead of tax season for Q3.
Source: Meta Advanced Analytics; cohorts de-duplicated; 30d post-view, 30d post-click attribution. Conversions include non-DC purchases.

ANZ · BPROBrand impact · Toluna

Aided AI-perception of Acrobat Studio is moving; unaided perception needs longer ad exposure to land

+15
ppt lift among 25–54s agreeing Acrobat Studio "has AI tools that help me get insights across multiple documents" (95% sig.)
"Strong category education sometimes comes at the cost of a tighter race in single-choice unaided questions — a normal effect when shifting into a more competitive AI category."
An 8-week Demand Creation push reached 75% of 25–54s through OOH and 67% through Social. Half of 25–44s saw 3+ media channels, and post-OOH exposure 89% of recallers took action — including 21% subscribing to Acrobat Studio.
UP
+5 ppt aided lift across 25–54s
"Acrobat has AI tools that let me do more with PDFs" — driven by AI-feature-centric creative.
FLAT
−5 ppt unaided ("AI-powered PDF space")
Exposed audiences recognise more AI competitors, spreading single-choice answers across the category.
NEXT
Q3 ask: sustain reach to convert aided into unaided
Re-explore go-big cultural moments (post-AO success) and continue measurement to track spontaneous AI association.
Source: oOh! Brand Outcomes Study; Toluna Brand Lift Study. Sample: n=1,004 (Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide, Perth). Period: March 2026.

Region · Korea

Korea CPRO

Search restructured for the new AI / LLM landscape, with Meta and ACE channels driving SARR efficiency.
Korea · CPROProject Search Horizon

Restructuring Naver Search around AI-driven discovery tripled impressions while cutting CPLT

Before · Weeks 8–10

Keyword-centric structure, BAU bidding

1.83M
Impressions · $60.6K spend · 1,476 LTUs · $41.06 CPLT
  • Optimised at the keyword level; no AI-extended search coverage.
  • Limited visibility into Naver's emerging LLM behaviour patterns.
After · Weeks 11–13

Product-portfolio + AI-extended structure

4.75M
Impressions · $49.9K spend · 1,298 LTUs · $38.46 CPLT
  • +160% impressions, −18% spend, −6% CPLT — efficiency gain at scale.
  • Keyword roles now classified as Brand / Needs / Features; AI-expanded surfaces matched to user intent.
  • Q2 priority: extend the structure across all CC categories and pilot ads inside Copilot / ChatGPT.
Source: Naver Search Platform and PPP Dashboard. Project Search Horizon: 4-pillar rework (Brilliant Basics, Knowledge Empowerment, AMO Test & Learn, Future Forward).

Region · Southeast Asia

SEA & Mobile

Non-brand search expansion into ID and PH, plus mobile's halo on Document Cloud demand.
SEA · MobileGrowth opportunity

SEA is a high-growth driver and mobile halo only flows through to Document Cloud demand

Spend × SARR · all clouds
0.96
Strong correlation between spend and Sourced ARR across CPG and DPG in SEA. Y/Y GNARR growing at DMe level every quarter, with SEA GDP projected at ~4.6% in 2026.

Non-Brand Search is the fastest path to scale. Plan to expand into ID and PH starting W6/W7 with Photo, Design and Video segments — adding PMax for Photo to leverage incremental reach.

Mobile halo is asymmetric. Increased mobile spend in SEA correlated weakly with CPG conversion (similar use cases between web/mobile aren't translating), but DPG showed a clearer signal (mobile spend × SU at 0.24) — Acrobat audiences move between Reader and web seamlessly.

Local champions matter. Layer GCash in PH and Grab in ID/TH alongside Google to capture commerce intent and inventory coverage in a fragmented landscape.

Source: Paid Media Period-to-Period Performance (PPP) Extended; ACE channels FY25Q1–FY26Q2; GWI Google SEA Market Insights; IMF World Economic Outlook.
